versos.texto_bv: Arrependa-se, portanto! Se não, virei a você rapidamente e guerrearei contra eles com a espada da minha boca.
versos.traducao_literal: Arrepende-te pois; se porém não, venho a-ti rapidamente e guerrearei com eles com a espada da boca de-mim.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): 'rapidamente' traduz o advérbio grego (ταχύ) no sentido de modo/velocidade; as três referências convergem no sentido temporal ('em breve/sem demora'), mais idiomático no registro de advertência escatológica. — evidência: NTLH: 'eu logo irei até aí'; ARA: 'virei a ti em breve'; NVIPT: 'virei em breve até você'; BV/traducao_literal: 'rapidamente'.

kjv.texto: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

vizinhos.15: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
vizinhos.17: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.

web.texto: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

vizinhos.15: So you also have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans likewise.
vizinhos.17: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which no one knows but he who receives it.
